metrics.definition: Sum captured payments by capture time. Duplicate captured payments remain in gross receipts.
Gross captured receipts minus refunds, with refunds attributed by their refund time.
Count distinct orders with a captured payment in the requested period.
Captured receipts during the spend period from customers who signed up during the cohort period.
A subscription is active if it started on or before the instant and its end time is absent or strictly later.
Divide subscriptions active at the start that terminate during the month by subscriptions active at the start.
Compare the paid invoice total to captured payments on that invoice. Refunds are excluded from this comparison.
Decompose the change in net receipts into paid order volume, average gross receipts per paid order, and refunds. Average receipts per order combine pricing, product mix and payment effects.
